description: This Java source file defines the ResponseHelper class, which provides static methods to generate autofill Dataset objects with various presentations, intended for use in Android autofill services. It customizes datasets for unlocked and locked states, including inline suggestions, dialog prompts, and dropdown menus. The class also includes a helper method for creating dataset presentation RemoteViews.

classes.name: ResponseHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate autofill datasets with various presentations for Android autofill services.

methods.name: newUnlockedDataset
methods.description: Creates a new autofill dataset with inline, dropdown, and dialog presentations for unlocked state, including inline suggestions if requested.

methods.name: newLockedDataset
methods.description: Creates a locked autofill dataset that prompts for authentication before filling, including inline, dropdown, and dialog presentations.

methods.name: newDatasetPresentation
methods.description: Constructs a RemoteViews object for the dataset presentation with specified text.
